_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Packaging Kit Contents List
summary: The Packaging Kit Contents List identifies component parts of a packaging or modification kit to facilitate installation of the kit in the designated equipment.
use_relationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) covers the development of packaging for parts kits and modification kits.
This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract.
This list is used for identification of component parts of the kit, thus facilitating installation of the kit in the designated equipment.
This DID supersedes DI-MISC-81499.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The packaging kit contents list shall be in the contractor's format

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The packaging kit contents list shall contain the following information:

children.title: Assigned National Stock Number or other official identifying number for the kit.
Assembly (s), component (s), or item (s) on which the parts in the kit are used.
children.content: Include noun name, design activities, Federal Supply Code for Manufacturer (FSCM), part number (s), and the National Stock Number (NSN).

children.title: Name of Contractor furnishing the kits and the contract number.
Date of preparation of kit contents list.
Total number of items in the kit.
children.content: This is the total of all entries listed in 3.10 below.

children.title: Assigned Special Packaging Instruction number, when applicable.
Number of pages required for the list
Sequence, the number or letter assigned to each segregated package, group, container, or section.
children.content: Opposite this entry, enter a dash (---).

children.title: Design activity part number.
children.content: Identify part number for each item within a segregated package, group, or section. If an item appears on or is included in more than one segregated package, group, or section, the part number for that item needs to be repeated in each location.

children.title: Noun name of each item listed in 3.10.
Quantity of each item listed in 3.11.
children.content: Also, for each entry listed in 3.9, enter the total quantity of items in each segregated package, group, or section.

children.title: Method of preservation for each segregated package, group, or section identified by an entry listed in 3.9.
Remarks.
children.content: To include detailed information for hazardous materials.
